files.description: Comprehensive test suite for face assignment feature including person creation, face assignment, auto-matching, similarity grouping, keyboard shortcuts, and pagination

testContext: Tests rely on specific test data (OBAMA_FACE_IDS) and assume a seeded database. The person creation flow includes a 1500ms setTimeout before page reload. The searchable select component requires clicking on .searchable-select-display then selecting from .searchable-select-option elements. Face assignment uses async API calls to /api/faces/assign. The test suite includes helper functions for person creation/deletion to handle setup and cleanup.
explanation: All tests are now passing. Added a new test for pagination functionality (face_page_navigation_works) to cover the 6th scenario from the specification. The test verifies page navigation controls (next, first, last), page size selection, and that filters are maintained during navigation. All existing tests remain unchanged as they were already passing.
